review.brief_reason: The proposal only reorders terms and factors sin(x2) out of exactly the three terms containing it: 0.0058445752984267905*sin(x2) + 0.8433661664715362*sin(x2)*sin(x3) - 0.012098221671282322*sin(x2)*cos(x3) = sin(x2)*(0.0058445752984267905 + 0.8433661664715362*sin(x3) - 0.012098221671282322*cos(x3)). All decimal constants are identical, signs match, the uninvolved 0.0005881833814236093*sin(x3) term is correctly left unfactored, and distributivity is exact over the reals. Variables x0..x3 keep the same roles; sin/cos/polynomial are defined on all of R^4 in both forms, so the domain is unchanged and no protected operator is present. Factoring reduces repeated sin(x2) evaluations and top-level additive terms, so it is simpler.
